tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. chB:B.5Suppose $F: M \to \mathcal{T}^{(k,l)} T M$ is a rough $(k,l)$-tensor field. Show that $F$ is smooth on an open set $U \subseteq M$ if and only if whenever $\omega ^1, \ldots , \omega ^k$ are smooth covector fields and $X_1, \ldots , X_l$ are smooth vector fields defined on $U$, the real-valued function $F(\omega ^1, \ldots , \omega ^k, X_1, \ldots , X_l)$, defined on $U$ by \[ F(\omega ^1, \ldots , \omega ^k, X_1, \ldots , X_l)(p) = F_p(\omega ^1|_p, \ldots , \omega ^k|_p, X_1|_p, \ldots , X_l|_p), \] is smooth. \end{exercise}
